responsibility: This module is GCC's GNU C front end: it turns C source text into GCC trees and initial lowered forms while enforcing C language rules and integrating C into the compiler driver and language-hook framework. Its core files cover parsing and token handling for C and shared C/Objective-C syntax, declaration and scope management, construction and type checking of expressions, conversions, initializers, C-specific constant folding, and diagnostics. In localization terms, parser files own source grammar and token interpretation, decl files own scopes and declarations, and c-typeck files own semantic expression typing such as composite-type compatibility, qualifiers, conversions, initializer nesting, lvalue rules, conditional/binary operators, calls, returns, and va_arg. The module also defines the C front end's language data structures, tree extensions, and lang_hooks wiring, provides support utilities such as -aux-info output and driver-side specs, and includes special parsing paths for textual GIMPLE and embedded low-level bodies, distinguishing it from middle-end optimization modules by owning source-language semantics, diagnostics, and front-end lowering for C.
